prompts.idle: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: production 6-frame idle animation sprite sheet for a Windows desktop companion. Reference image is the ONLY identity/style reference, not an existing animation frame. Re-draw this exact same girl in 6 genuinely drawn animation keyframes. Preserve her exact face, huge black rounded-square glasses, off-center black fringe with visible part, long black hair, navy varsity jacket with ivory collar/cuffs/placket, white shirt, blue distressed jeans with tiny colorful patches, white sneakers, same chibi proportions and pixel-textured shaded illustration aesthetic. Do not make her a different anime character, do not simplify to flat vector, do not change outfit or glasses. Output a 1536x1024 transparent RGBA sprite atlas, EXACTLY 3 columns by 2 rows, six equal 512x512 cells. One fully visible character per cell, same fixed scale, camera and foot baseline in every cell: crown around y45 and soles y478 within each cell; horizontal center x256, ample transparent gutter. No cell borders, no labels, no text, no background, no floor shadow. Reading order left to right then next row: 1 neutral relaxed reference-like stance; 2 gentle inhale with slightly raised shoulders and subtle hand/finger relaxation; 3 eyes half close for a blink, glasses intact, slight hair secondary motion; 4 eyes closed naturally, head tilts very slightly, eyelids correctly drawn BEHIND glasses; 5 eyes reopen, shoulders settle and jacket folds/hair follow naturally; 6 returns toward neutral stance for a seamless return to frame1. Motion is character acting with anatomically coherent redraws and cloth/hair follow-through, not rigid translation, not warped pixels. Keep the same original front three-quarter view in ALL six cells. True transparent background.
